pretraining_stimulus_revision.reason: The first 1.2-mV-equivalent, 20-ms Level 3 pulse produced zero DAN spikes in the frozen LIF model; no learning was run. The 2.0-unit, 20-ms PAM pulse was already specified in docs/B2_CANDIDATE1_DESIGN.md, and its LIF threshold-crossing time is approximately 13.9 ms at tau_m=20 ms.

dan_identity: PAM08(y4)_L; MaleCNS-v1 traced DAN; dopamine consensus

dan_stimulation.onset: fixed Level 2 teacher event time: observation window plus inherited 1000-us lag
dan_stimulation.model: same LIF parameters and dt as the frozen Level 2 circuit; fresh resting DAN state per presentation
dan_stimulation.activity_gate: 1.0 if at least one observed DAN spike during the fixed current pulse; otherwise 0.0

local_gate.anatomical_rule: Only KC→MBON05 weight slots whose KC receives a measured DAN-87177→KC contact with both synaptic endpoints in g4(L) can change; all 32 original weights and initial values remain present.
local_gate.plasticity_rule: Level 2 presentation-local eligibility and LTD formula; replace artificial teacher bit by observed DAN spike activity. This is an engineering assumption.
local_gate.no_dan_activity: zero LTD update regardless of eligibility
local_gate.dan_to_mbon05_direct_pair: 48 measured contacts are recorded in the audit but no direct electrical effect is added to this reduced readout; its physiological effect is unknown.

training.schedule: exact frozen Level 2 v2.5 120-block, 1200-presentation sequence in each arm
training.evaluation: frozen teacher/plasticity-off full position grid after each block and at completion

scope: Engineering DAN activity bridge only; no visual, motor, decoder, RPE, or osu timing pathway
